faq.question: What is GEO or AEO?
faq.answer: Generative engine optimization and answer engine optimization. Both mean making your business the source that AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews quote when someone asks a question in your field.

faq.question: Is SEO still worth it if people use AI search?
faq.answer: Yes. AI tools pull heavily from pages that already rank and carry authority, so strong SEO is the foundation of AI visibility.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: Technical fixes can show up within weeks. Authority and rankings build over months, which is why the program runs a 13-week minimum.

faq.question: How do you measure AI visibility?
faq.answer: We run the same set of buyer questions across AI engines at the start and end of each cycle and track how often you're cited.

faq.question: What's the difference between the playbook and your program?
faq.answer: The playbook is the 90-day system you run yourself for $197. The program is the same system, run by us, with the technical work, content and reporting done for you.

closing.Heading: Find out whether AI search knows you exist.
closing.Line: The AI Search Audit shows where you're cited, where competitors are cited instead and what to fix first.
